messages:
jamie: Anyone up for a "Pocket Pickup" this Sat? Switch + Steam Deck high-score relay in the lounge. 6pm. Bring controllers/chargers. I'm bringing projector :projector:
renee: Yes! I'll bring my Switch + dock. Also have an extra Pro Controller to lend :handshake:
marco: Can I bring my Steam Deck? Battery life meh — anyone got a spare power bank or USB-C hub? :raising_hand:
tina: I can bring a 65W PD brick and a short USB-C cable. Need HDMI? Projector has HDMI input. Also have a mini HDMI->USB-C adapter if needed.
kyle: I'll sign up. Suggest we do 3-player relay squads. Rules: first to 100k moves on. Also can we do a tiny prize? winner gets 'lounge brag badge' :trophy:
jamie: Love it. I'll make a tiny scoreboard in a Google Sheet and drop link. Also is anyone allergic to chips? planning to bring garlic chips (sry) :grimacing:
renee: no garlic allergy here :ok_hand: but can someone grab napkins? last time we had crumbs everywhere.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: Pocket Pickup — Sat 6pm-9pm (link: https://cal.example/evt/1785432100)
marco: Added myself to sheet. Quick tech Q: Steam Deck dock needs DisplayPort or USB-C alt mode; bringing a hub w/DP out. jamie — do you have a small adapter for SD audio? last projector was a bit hissy.
tina: Quick checklist:
```
- Switch dock
- Steam Deck
- 1x PD brick
- HDMI cable
- Pro controller
- Snacks
```
I'll bring napkins too.
kyle: Also if anyone wants to queue indie co-op, bring controllers: local multiplayer suggestions welcome. If turnout >8 maybe split into rounds.
renee: :thumbsup: I'll bring extra joy-con strap thingies.
jamie: Sweet. Count me, @renee, @marco, @tina, @kyle — 5 so far. Ping if you arrive late. See you Sat! :sparkles:
